verdict.rationale: Skills ship as SKILL.md folders installable through the open `skills` CLI across Claude Code, Codex and Pi. The repo also carries portable Agent Plugins metadata alongside Cursor metadata, which strongly implies the folders work beyond YYLO's own tooling. Nothing explicitly claims conformance to the open Agent Skills specification, and the validator checks internal contracts rather than spec compliance. Missing for 10: explicit statement of Agent Skills spec conformance, spec-level validation (frontmatter/schema checks), independent corroboration of cross-vendor use.
